title: In Ravenwood: the badge list arrives enveloped and the spellbook opens, and a server message longer than a short frame reaches the client
notes: 3.02's badge check and 1.18's long-frame question in one in-world run: after the wizard stands in Ravenwood the game server has sent
MSG_BADGES with its BadgeInfo and BadgeFilterInfo enveloped; the run opens the spellbook, where the client keeps its badges, and shots it.
Then a game console announcement of 16000 characters makes one MSG_SERVERMESSAGE frame of about 32000 bytes, over the 0x7780 a short
frame's length can say, so the frame is sent long; the client's log shows whether it read the message.
With the game server's session log at DEBUG, it decodes its own LOGINCOMPLETE Data after encoding it and says what it holds, which 4.11 records.
The game server also saves the exact LOGINCOMPLETE Data it sends under its folder's logincomplete, which client core reads afterwards against the install's types; the bytes stay local.
The wizard is level 25 with the experience that level holds; its school badge, Pyromancer, is read from the install's Badges table and shown after the Badges tab and its first filter are chosen.
server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added

steps.name: the client brings its renderer up
steps.pattern: About to initialize graphical client\.

steps.name: the login window is on the screen
log in
the server decodes the authentication message field by field
steps.pattern: sent MSG_USER_AUTHEN_V3: version (W\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+), revision \S+, data revision \S+, locale \S+, machine [0-9A-F]+,

steps.name: the server accepts the password
steps.pattern: authenticated as {user} \(id \d+\)

steps.name: the client is admitted
steps.pattern: The LoginServer has admitted the user

steps.name: the server lists the wizard the run made
steps.pattern: listed (\d+) character\(s\) of account \d+

steps.name: the character selection scene loads
steps.pattern: WizardCharacterSelect: The scene has been loaded successfully\.

steps.name: the character selection screen is on the screen
the wizard on the character selection screen
press play

until.pattern: sent account \d+ with wizard (\d+) to realm

steps.name: the game server spends the key
steps.pattern: Session \d+ attached: account \d+ with wizard (\d+)

steps.name: the game server sends the wizard its object
steps.pattern: put wizard \d+ in (\S+) instance \d+ at .* and sent its \d+-byte object

steps.name: the object the client is sent begins 68 02 01000000 and decodes whole
steps.pattern: MSG_LOGINCOMPLETE Data holds (\d+ bytes inside its envelope, beginning 68 02 01 00 00 00, and decodes whole with 0 issue)

steps.name: the client loading the zone
the client loads the zone and the wizard stands in it
steps.pattern: loaded (\S+), and wizard \d+ stands in the world

steps.name: the wizard standing in Ravenwood
the game server answers the timed access passes
steps.pattern: Session \d+ asked for its timed access passes and was told it has none

steps.name: the game server answers the subscriber-only items
steps.pattern: Session \d+ asked which items only subscribers may use and was told none

steps.name: the game server takes the end of shopping
steps.pattern: Session \d+ is done shopping, transaction \d+

steps.name: the game server takes the screen the client runs at
steps.pattern: Session \d+ runs its client at (\d+x\d+)

steps.name: the wizard is still connected at the next keepalive
steps.pattern: Session \d+ keepalive from the client

steps.name: the wizard still standing
the game server sends the wizard its rank badges
steps.pattern: Session \d+ told its wizard it holds (\d+) badge\(s\): (.*)

steps.name: open the spellbook
the spellbook
turn to the Character page
the Character page and its badges
open the Badges tab
the badge filters
open the first badge filter
the Badges page
the wizard is still connected after the badge window opens
steps.pattern: Session \d+ keepalive from the client

steps.name: close the spellbook
announce a message long enough for a long frame
steps.pattern: Shown to (\d+) wizard

steps.name: the client reads the long server message
steps.pattern: Server Message: LLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLLL

steps.name: the long message shown
the client loaded every object the server sent
steps.pattern: LoadObject Failed|LoadObject tried to read more data
